title: Kitne Hisso Me Mulaqat Karoge Baba
body:
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Qaid Mein Dekh Kar Sar, Bibi Sakina Ne Kaha
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Haye Kal Maine Bayaban Mein Tan Dekha Hai
Aur Ab Qaid Mein Zalim Ne Ye Sar Bheja Hai
Kya Mukammal Na Kabhi Mujhse Miloge Baba
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Kya Kabhi Mujhko Gale Se Na Lagaoge Pedar
Jeete Ji Dekhna Paungi Main Ye Seena-O-Sar
Maar Dalega Sakina Ko Yahi Ek Sadma
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
In Labon Ke Liya Karte The Mohammad Bose
Khoon Mein Tar Hain Ye Lab, Mara Hai Patthar Kisne
Aapko Dekh Ke Phatta Hai Kaleja Mera
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Aapka Tan Sar-E-Maqtal Hai, Khabar Hai Mujhko
Kya Kiya Hoga Sitamgar Ne, Ye Dar Hai Mujhko
Kya Koi Hissa Badan Ka Hai Salamat Baba
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Aapke Baad Bahut Zulm Hua Hai Mujh Par
Dekhiye Shimr Ki Ungli Ke Nishan Hain Rukh Par
Itni Zakhmi Hun, Kafan Hoga Ye Kurta Mera
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Shimr Kehta Tha Karo In Pe Sitam Ab Aise
Aao Mil Jul Ke Karo Ek Badan Ke Tukde
Maine Zalim Ki Zuban Se Ye Suna Hai Jumla
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Karbala Ja Ke Main Mahfooz Karungi Baba
Mujhko Batlaiye Tukde Main Chunungi Baba
Kya Khabar Thi Use Mar Jayegi Wo Khud Dukhiya
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Ek Angoothi Ke Liye Kaati Gayi Thi Ungli
Aur Patke Ke Liye Kaatta Tha Haath Koi
Bhai Sajjad Se Ye Maine Suna Hai Noha
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Seena Bhi Bhej Do Zindan Mein, Ye Kahiye Baba
Ek Muddat Hui So Payi Nahin Ye Dukhiya
Main Sakina Hun Ke Wo Seena Hai Bistar Mera
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
Aye Sharar Naqvi, Sada Aayi Sar-E-Sarwar Se
Lene Aaye Hain Chalo Qaid Ke Ab Is Ghar Se
Ab Mukammal Tumhein Jannat Mein Milenge Baba
Kitne Hisson Mein Mulaqat Karoge Baba
